Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Lee
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver
Date: 02/10/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 75 as passed the House of Representatives could increase or decrease the administrative obligations of the Board of Pharmacy by an undetermined amount dependent on the number of disciplinary actions that are sent by delivery or courier service, as provided by this bill, as opposed to certified mail, as provided by current law. Further, this bill shifts the administration of the election procedure for certain Board positions to a third party, which would decrease the administrative obligations of the Board but increase the financial obligations of the Board by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost to have the third party administer the election process.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs
